$comment: Import spellings a consumer of @kingsleyweb/bun-client writes, checked against the packed tarball by `bun scripts/consumer-check.ts packages/bun-client` from the repo root. Every entry but the generator is a browser entry: the client runs in browsers and must type-check there without Bun or Node types. The generator (`./codegen`) is Bun-only and dev-time, so it is checked as an ordinary entry. The one runtime dependency, @kingsleyweb/bun-contract (loaded lazily, for validation), is packed beside it. The ./zod entries need the optional zod peer, the ./query entries the optional @tanstack/query-core peer, the ./react entries react and @tanstack/react-query beside query-core (their declarations import ./query's), and the ./persist entries the optional @tanstack/query-persist-client-core peer (types only): they are checked in the consumer that has them (`peers`), every other entry in one without either. The ./sse entries (the event-stream client) need no peer. The ./channel entries (the WebSocket channel client) need no peer either; their snippet builds its contract with @kingsleyweb/bun-contract, the dependency.
